Resolves #5076

An unchecked required checkbox/radio group now shows one error below its last eligible member while every required member remains invalid. `getGroupItems()` returns the logical form/path group in current container order; radio exclusivity uses its DOM grouping mode to match the rendered name and form owner. The public form example no longer needs per-choice suppression flags.

Evidence: L3 (Chromium interaction, native form-owner/config agreement, public form example and inspected captures) → L3 required for the visible group behavior. No residuals.

## AC Evidence

No structured ACs on #5076. The original single-message request and the [current contract](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/5076#issuecomment-6658117968) are covered by `unit/form/field/CheckBoxGroup.spec.mjs` and the component CheckBox/Radio specs: shared validity, order changes, insertion/removal, hidden/text opt-outs, optional choices, independent errors, rendered namespaces, windows and real versus logical forms.

## Deltas from ticket

Validation and `getGroupValue()` keep the logical closest-form/full-path boundary, including field-change event data. Native exclusivity follows the rendered form owner: a logical form can render as a `div`. A logical form without a selection remains invalid even when another logical form owns the native group's selection. The intake records both the DOM/config falsifier and this validity/value check. No new group container, registry or caller config is required.

## Test Evidence

The public form's CheckBoxes page renders one error after Lemon and Orange are unchecked, and clears it when Strawberry is checked. Its captured layout was inspected. The first eight unit cases failed on the original duplicate-message and group-boundary behavior; a later browser falsifier caught the logical-`div`-form mismatch before commit. All retained unit and component coverage runs in CI.

`agent-preflight` is not hosted in this Engine checkout; PR-body, source hooks, diff and file-size checks run directly.

## Post-Merge Validation

None required beyond the verified behavior.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** the #5076 body and the intake contract comment (6658117968), `dev` source of `src/form/field/CheckBox.mjs` and `Radio.mjs` (the global `ComponentManager.find({ntype, name})` scans in `validate()` and `uncheckGroupItems()`), `apps/form/view/pages/Page4.mjs` (the per-choice `showErrorTexts` workaround), and our own design exchange on this lane earlier today.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** One group resolver in the field family, inherited by Radio. Its logical mode (closest form + full data path) serves validation and `getGroupValue()`. Its rendered mode (DOM name + nearest rendered `<form>`) serves native radio exclusivity. The message owner should be the last eligible required member in container order, computed at validation time. It must not hardcode registry order, global name matching, or one app's form class. Isolation: unit specs on in-memory forms, and browser specs where the native form owner matters.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. `getGroupItems(useDomGrouping)` implements both scopes. `validate()` and `getGroupValue()` take the default logical scope, and `uncheckGroupItems()` takes `getGroupItems(true)`. Order comes from each field's ancestor path with `parent.items`, not the registry. The owner is `findLast(...)` over required, text-allowing, non-hidden members, recomputed each time.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert: the rendered-owner falsifier caught the `div`-form mismatch before the commit, and the contract records it. Coheres with friction→gold: an engine rule replaces a per-app workaround, and `Page4` loses its flags.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: The message owner is chosen only during validation, and eligibility checks `hidden` alone.
  - A member that is invisible some other way can own the message: a card in an inactive tab under `removeInactiveCards` gets `removeDom`, not `hidden`, and the message then renders nowhere.
  - Hiding the current owner at runtime does not re-elect another member until the next validation.

  Both match your contract ("the next validation observes…"), and groups rarely span cards. It is non-blocking and needs no ticket unless a consumer hits it.
- **Documented search**: I actively looked for these and found no concerns:
  - **A transient duplicate.** For a non-owner, `field.error = error` renders the text through `afterSetError`, and `updateError(…, false)` then retracts it. A browser probe watched three required checkboxes with a `MutationObserver` while the only checked one was clicked. On this head, no error text ever appeared on the two non-owners; one message landed on the last member. On `dev`, the same scenario renders 3 messages, so the probe can see duplicates.
  - **A subclass dropping the new `showText` argument.** No `updateError` override exists below `CheckBox`.
  - **Close keywords in the branch commits.** The single commit carries only `(#5076)`.

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: A Neo form field has two group boundaries. The logical one (closest `form.Container` and full data path) owns values and validity. The rendered one (DOM `name` and the nearest real `<form>`) owns native radio exclusivity. They differ whenever a logical form renders as a `div`, so a group helper has to name which one it means.
